title: Gaussian noise at zero correlation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $[?]f$ be a real-valued function on $[?]\mathbb R^n$, and let $[?]\gamma$ be the product of $n$ standard Gaussian probability measures. At correlation parameter $0$, the Gaussian noise operator is the constant function whose value is the integral of $f$ with respect to $[?]\gamma$: for every $x\in\mathbb R^n$, $(T_0f)(x)=\int_{\mathbb R^n} f\,d\gamma$.
